classification_definitions.unresolved: Conditional parent-owned process helper or insufficient/contradictory source prevents candidate accounting; affected later assertions stay uncredited.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION. No compiler/tests/Go/helpers/scanner/signing/crypto/cloud/process probes or service execution.
Expiry integration is real local file-open/read only; no credential deployment, issuer trust, server auth, renewal or rotation execution.

Admission/producer/credential targets use synthetic ObjectClient, receipts, fencer, native validator and credential store. No OCI, Vault, SQL, TerraBase, NATS or host runtime credit for those unit roots.

Three Rust-supplied qualification child roots remain unresolved under dispatcher-confirmed rule. The exact actual NATS/Unix/process source paths are recorded, not qualified. No external Rust parent receipts reviewed.

Conditional process fixture uses upstream NATS server and loopback TCP, FileStorage, replicas=1. No natscell.Start/in-process transport, R3 replication, TLS/auth/failover or production host Agent path credit.

Full producer continuation is source blocked by invalid d10-N SeatIDs. Its fake object store never proves OCI/KMS. Later material receipt operation ID is noncanonical too. No later material/runtime assertions credited.
Static frozen Rust fixtures are byte constants only. Local cryptographic compatibility assertions do not validate Rust live behavior or production credential/backup publication safety.
Every original assertion, security/failure/retry/ordering and byte-preservation obligation remains retained. No retirement/deletion/ledger/count promotion/runtime qualification/global completion.
